entities.summary: Leader of United States of America (1969–1974). 37th; Republican; VP under Eisenhower; opened China 1972 (Mao meeting); ended Vietnam draft; Watergate scandal (break-in, cover-up); resigned August 1974 (only president to resign, facing impeachment)
